# Block catalogue (generated by `npm run docs` — do not edit)

34 blocks. Each rule = 1 trigger + optional conditions + ordered actions.

## Triggers

| Block | What it does | Inspired by |
|---|---|---|
| `trigger.issue_created` | Fires once, when an issue is first reported. | Jira Automation: Issue created; Linear: new issue → triage; Asana: Task added to project; Trello Butler: card created |
| `trigger.field_changed` | Fires when a field changes, optionally only to/from a specific value (status moves, priority bumps, reassignments). | Jira Automation: Field value changed; ClickUp: When status changes; Monday.com: When column changes to; Asana: Custom field changes |
| `trigger.issue_resolved` | Fires when an issue moves into a resolved state. | Jira Automation: Issue transitioned (Done); GitHub Projects: Item closed → Done; Linear: issue completed |
| `trigger.issue_reopened` | Fires when a resolved issue becomes unresolved again. | GitHub Projects: Item reopened; Jira Automation: Issue reopened; Zendesk: ticket reopened |
| `trigger.comment_added` | Fires when a comment is added; optionally only when written by the reporter (customer reply). | Jira Automation: Issue commented; Zendesk: requester replied; Linear: comment added |
| `trigger.schedule_stale` | Daily sweep over unresolved issues untouched for N days, optionally restricted to certain states. | Linear: auto-close stale issues; GitHub: stale bot; Jira Automation: Scheduled JQL 'updated <= -14d' |
| `trigger.schedule_due` | Daily sweep over unresolved issues whose Due Date falls within the next N days (today inclusive). | Asana Rules: Due date approaches; Monday.com: When date arrives; Trello Butler: due date commands; ClickUp: Due date arrives |
| `trigger.schedule_overdue` | Daily sweep over unresolved issues whose Due Date is in the past. | Jira: overdue filter; Asana: overdue tasks; ClickUp: overdue automations |
| `trigger.schedule_search` | Run on a cron schedule over any YouTrack search query (advanced escape hatch; query charset is restricted). | Jira Automation: Scheduled trigger with JQL; Monday.com: Every time period |

## Conditions

| Block | What it does | Inspired by |
|---|---|---|
| `condition.field_is` | True when the field's current value is one of `values` (use negate for 'is none of'). | Jira Automation: Issue fields condition; Asana: Task has custom field value; ClickUp: If field equals |
| `condition.field_empty` | empty=true → field has no value; empty=false → field has a value. | Jira Automation: field is empty; Asana: Task is unassigned; Linear: no assignee/estimate |
| `condition.has_tag` | True when the issue carries (or lacks, with negate) the given tag. | Trello Butler: card has label; Jira: labels condition; GitHub: has label |
| `condition.summary_contains` | Case-insensitive match of any keyword in the summary (keyword triage, e.g. 'crash', 'outage'). | Zendesk triggers: subject contains; Jira Automation: smart value contains; Linear: triage rules |
| `condition.current_user_in_group` | True when the user making the change belongs to the YouTrack group (role gate). | Jira Automation: User condition; Jira: Transition permissions; ClickUp: permissions on automation |
| `condition.all_subtasks_resolved` | True when the issue has subtasks and every one of them is resolved. | Jira Automation: Related issues condition; Asana: all subtasks complete; ClickUp: all subtasks done |
| `condition.has_subtasks` | True when the issue is a parent of at least one subtask. | Jira: issue has subtasks; Asana: task has subtasks |
| `condition.all_of` | Nested group: true when every inner condition is true. | Jira Automation: condition blocks / AND; Zendesk: Meet ALL conditions |
| `condition.any_of` | Nested group: true when at least one inner condition is true. | Jira Automation: if/else, OR; Zendesk: Meet ANY condition |
| `condition.not` | Negates a single inner condition. | Jira Automation: NOT; Boolean logic in every rule builder |

## Actions

| Block | What it does | Inspired by |
|---|---|---|
| `action.set_field` | Set a field to a value. Enum/state fields use declared values; string/integer set literals. onlyIfEmpty avoids overwriting. | Jira Automation: Edit issue; Asana: Set custom field; ClickUp: Change status/priority; Monday.com: Change column |
| `action.assign` | Set Assignee: a fixed login, the reporter, the acting user, unassigned, or deterministic round-robin over `logins` (by issue number). | Jira Automation: Assign issue; Linear: triage auto-assign / round-robin; Asana: Assign to; GitHub: CODEOWNERS-style routing |
| `action.route_by_field` | Assign by lookup table, e.g. Subsystem → owning engineer; optional fallback login. | Jira: component lead auto-assign; Zendesk: group routing; GitHub: CODEOWNERS |
| `action.add_tag` | Attach a tag to the issue. | Trello: add label; Jira: add labels; GitHub: add label |
| `action.remove_tag` | Detach a tag from the issue. | Trello: remove label; Jira: remove labels |
| `action.add_comment` | Post a comment. Placeholders: {{issue.id}} {{issue.summary}} {{issue.reporter}} {{issue.assignee}} {{issue.project}} {{currentUser}} {{field:Name}}. | Jira Automation: Add comment; Asana: Add comment; Zendesk: auto-reply |
| `action.notify` | Send an email/in-app notification to assignee, reporter, acting user, or a login. | Jira Automation: Send email; Asana: Add follower / notify; Monday.com: Notify someone; Trello Butler: mention member |
| `action.message` | Show a transient message in the UI of the user who made the change. | Jira: validators with feedback; ClickUp: toast on automation |
| `action.require_field` | Block the change (with message) unless the field has a value — a Definition-of-Done / entry-criteria gate. Pair with trigger.field_changed. | Jira: workflow validators / required fields on transition; Linear: required estimate; ClickUp: required custom fields in status |
| `action.require_subtasks_resolved` | Block the change unless all subtasks are resolved. | Jira: 'Sub-task blocker' validator; Asana: dependencies must finish; ClickUp: block close with open subtasks |
| `action.wip_limit` | Block moving into `state` if the assignee already has `limit` issues there (Kanban WIP limit). | Jira Kanban: column constraints; Trello Power-Up: list limits; Linear: cycle capacity |
| `action.set_due_in_days` | Set Due Date to now + N days (SLA/target dates). onlyIfEmpty keeps manual dates. | Asana Rules: Set due date relative; Jira SLA goals; Zendesk SLA policies |
| `action.escalate_priority` | Move a field up an ordered ladder (lowest→highest); stays at top. | Zendesk: escalation; Jira Service Mgmt: SLA breach escalation; PagerDuty: escalation policy |
| `action.close_parent_when_children_done` | For each parent of this issue: if all its subtasks are resolved, move parent State to `doneState`. | Jira Automation: close parent when all sub-tasks done (most popular recipe); Asana: auto-complete parent; GitHub Projects: tracked-by rollup |
| `action.block` | Unconditionally reject the change with a message. Use with conditions (e.g. 'not in group QA') to build permission gates. | Jira: transition conditions by role/group; ClickUp: restricted status changes; GitHub: branch protection |
